reason: Value/transfer lens. (1) The vote collapses to a relink-knob ablation. Both relinks re-run a full per-frame Hungarian over all nodes (exp56 cell 5 motion_relink_edges; ILP edges are replaced). Our cost is motion + 0.05*raw - 1.0*edge_prob with gates 5.5/10 (exp48 nb l.2007). The proposed third voter (x138 tail with FLOW_MODE off) uses motion + 0*raw - prob with the same 5.5/10 gates, so it differs from ours only by 0.05*raw (about 0.1 cost units at 2 um). On shared nodes voter 3 is a near-copy of our tail, and wherever the two main tails disagree the majority goes to ours. The fusion is therefore about 'x138 with the flow prior off', a relink-knob change (a closed class). The BRIEF names that prior as the stage that lets the head work on x138 (+0.007 there vs +0.002 on our plain relink), so the expected sign is <= 0. (2) The geometry tie-break, a multi-frame constant-velocity motion residual, is what the plain relink already minimises, so it pushes toward the non-flow choice too. Both tails' costs contain the in-sample edge probability (bonus 1.0), so the lab verdict inherits the same optimism that cost the edge filter on the LB (#29 lab +0.0162 -> LB 0 vs the exp39 base; #30 lab +0.0095 -> -0.001). (3) Ceiling from the metric: lab J = 122151/135729 = 0.900, and each FP+FN -> TP flip is worth dJ = (1+J)/U = 1.4e-5. +0.002 needs about 143 net correct flips, 0.11% of GT edges. The FN anatomy puts ~40% of FN in swaps (node-position errors; motion prefers our link in 98.6%, so the tie-break keeps them) and ~31% in missing detections. Neither can be fixed by re-choosing parents on a fixed node set, which leaves <= ~1.5% of GT edges as linking-type errors. Only part of those lie where the tails disagree, so the vote would need a win/loss ratio of roughly 60/40 or better against x138 there. Our tail lost to x138's by 0.003 overall, and ~+0.005 once our prune + DaughterNet gains are counted, so the realistic ratio is below 50/50. (4) The 0.003 public gap is not all parent choice. It also includes readmit (1,337 nodes on the dummies) and gapfill nodes that exist in only one tail, DeepCenter 0.25 vs 0.20 forks, the DivNet veto, leaf prune and DaughterNet. The vote touches none of these because it keeps x138's node set and forks. (5) A per-node majority over 3 global assignments is not itself an assignment: two targets can pick the same parent (spurious out-degree 2, i.e. unintended forks that the division Jaccard charges) or leave orphan ends. That needs a re-matching and a re-run of the short-track filter, which breaks the 'node count identical' guarantee and adds node-multiplier risk. (6) Transfer: the forum (739685) reports linker-only changes give exactly ~+0.001 LB while CV moves 0.01-0.03; LB noise is ~0.003-0.004 (byte-identical notebooks 0.946/0.942), so even a real +0.0005 is unobservable with one probe. Private: x138's tail was tuned on the public LB, so a hedge argument exists. But the same hedge comes for free, and better, from the planned F2 = exp51 (our tail) as the second final, which diversifies at the submission level with no build.
fix_if_any: Only a much narrower version could make sense. (a) Replace voter 3 with one that is independent of both relinks: a network-free, multi-frame (t-1, t, t+1, t+2) linear-motion re-assignment, solved as a constrained Hungarian over the disagreement set only, so the output stays a valid matching and x138's forks and nodes are untouched. (b) Resolve a disagreement only when the three voters agree 2:1 AND the alternative lowers the 3-frame residual by >= 1 um; otherwise keep x138. (c) Gate in the lab on the x138 cache with the edge-probability term set to 0 in all voters (removes the in-sample bias): >= +0.002 on BOTH embryos, >= 55% wins among changed videos, zero fork/node changes. Even so the realistic gain is <= +0.001 public (below the noise). It should not take an LB slot unless friend A's x138 cache exists by 26 Sep evening and the gate passes clearly. The cheaper private hedge is to tick exp51 (our tail + head) as F2 next to an x138-based F1.
realistic_public_gain: -0.002 to +0.001, mean ~ -0.0003 (argument: in effect this switches off x138's flow prior on the disagreement set; below the 0.003 LB noise either way)
realistic_private_gain: -0.002 to +0.002, mean ~0 (argument: a possible hedge against x138's public-tuned tail, but the finals pair F1 = x138-based and F2 = exp51 already gives that diversification at no cost)
